deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using the YAML sensor platform is deprecated.

Home Assistant could not reach the device while importing your configuration. Check the host and restart to retry the import, or remove the Google Wifi sensor YAML and add each device from the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: {domain} YAML configuration import failed

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_res.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using the YAML sensor platform is deprecated.

The device did not return Google Wifi status data, so the YAML configuration was not imported. Remove the Google Wifi sensor YAML and add each device from the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_res.title: [%key:component::google_wifi::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_connect::title%]

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using the YAML sensor platform is deprecated.

An unexpected error occurred while importing your configuration. Restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the Google Wifi sensor YAML and add each device from the UI.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_unknown.title: [%key:component::google_wifi::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_connect::title%]
